questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.text_en: Sculptor : Chisel :: Painter : ?
questions.text_hi: Sculptor : Chisel :: Painter : ?
questions.solution_en: A sculptor works with a chisel; a painter works with a brush. The relation is professional to the tool used.
questions.solution_hi: मूर्तिकार छेनी से काम करता है; चित्रकार ब्रश से। संबंध पेशेवर और प्रयुक्त उपकरण का है।
questions.trick_en: Identify the tool, not the material, in this analogy.
questions.trick_hi: इस सादृश्य में सामग्री नहीं, उपकरण पहचानें।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.solution_en: 343 = 7³, so the answer is 6³ = 216.
questions.solution_hi: 343 = 7³, इसलिए उत्तर 6³ = 216 है।
questions.trick_en: Check cubes before squares in number analogies.
questions.trick_hi: संख्या सादृश्य में वर्ग से पहले घन जाँचें।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.text_en: Book : Chapter :: Building : ?
questions.text_hi: Book : Chapter :: Building : ?
questions.solution_en: A chapter is a structural division of a book; a floor is a structural division of a building.
questions.solution_hi: अध्याय पुस्तक का संरचनात्मक भाग है; मंज़िल भवन का संरचनात्मक भाग है।
questions.trick_en: Prefer part-of-structure over raw material.
questions.trick_hi: कच्चे माल के बजाय संरचना के भाग को प्राथमिकता दें।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.text_en: Find the odd one out: Apple, Banana, Carrot, Mango.
questions.text_hi: बेमेल चुनें: Apple, Banana, Carrot, Mango।
questions.solution_en: Apple, banana and mango are fruits; carrot is a root vegetable.
questions.solution_hi: सेब, केला और आम फल हैं; गाजर जड़ वाली सब्ज़ी है।
questions.trick_en: Group by botanical category, not by colour.
questions.trick_hi: रंग से नहीं, वानस्पतिक वर्ग से समूह बनाएँ।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.text_en: Find the odd one out: 8, 27, 64, 100.
questions.solution_en: 8 = 2³, 27 = 3³ and 64 = 4³ are perfect cubes; 100 is a square, not a cube.
questions.solution_hi: 8 = 2³, 27 = 3³ और 64 = 4³ पूर्ण घन हैं; 100 वर्ग है, घन नहीं।
questions.trick_en: Test cubes for the first three numbers.
questions.trick_hi: पहले तीन संख्याओं के लिए घन जाँचें।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.text_en: Find the next term: 5, 11, 23, 47, ?
questions.solution_en: Each term is double the previous term plus 1: 5→11→23→47→95.
questions.solution_hi: प्रत्येक पद पिछले पद का दुगुना जमा 1 है: 5→11→23→47→95।
questions.trick_en: Check ×2 + 1 before assuming a constant difference.
questions.trick_hi: स्थिर अंतर मानने से पहले ×2 + 1 जाँचें।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.text_en: Find the next letter: M, O, Q, S, ?
questions.text_hi: अगला अक्षर ज्ञात कीजिए: M, O, Q, S, ?
questions.solution_en: The letters advance by +2 positions: M(13), O(15), Q(17), S(19), so next is U(21).
questions.trick_en: Convert to positions and check the gap.
questions.trick_hi: स्थानों में बदलें और अंतर जाँचें।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.text_en: Complete the series: Monday, Wednesday, Friday, ?
questions.text_hi: श्रृंखला पूरी करें: Monday, Wednesday, Friday, ?
questions.solution_en: The days advance by two: Monday → Wednesday → Friday → Sunday.
questions.solution_hi: दिन दो-दो आगे बढ़ते हैं: Monday → Wednesday → Friday → Sunday।
questions.trick_en: Count the skipped day each time.
questions.trick_hi: हर बार छूटे दिन को गिनें।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.text_en: If 5 * 3 = 28, where * means a² + b, what is 7 * 4?
questions.text_hi: यदि 5 * 3 = 28 है, जहाँ * का अर्थ a² + b है, तो 7 * 4 क्या है?
questions.trick_en: Verify the rule on the given example first.
questions.trick_hi: पहले दिए उदाहरण पर नियम जाँचें।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.text_en: In a code, EARTH is written as GCTVJ. How is MOON written in that code?
questions.text_hi: एक कोड में EARTH को GCTVJ लिखा जाता है। उसी कोड में MOON कैसे लिखा जाएगा?
questions.solution_en: Each letter moves two places forward: E→G, A→C, R→T, T→V, H→J. So M→O, O→Q, O→Q, N→P gives OQQP.
questions.solution_hi: प्रत्येक अक्षर दो स्थान आगे बढ़ता है: E→G, A→C, R→T, T→V, H→J। इसलिए M→O, O→Q, O→Q, N→P से OQQP बनता है।
questions.trick_en: Check the shift on every letter, including repeated letters.
questions.trick_hi: दोहराए अक्षरों सहित हर अक्षर पर बदलाव जाँचें।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.text_en: Which word can be formed using the letters of PRACTICE (each letter used only as often as it appears)?
questions.text_hi: PRACTICE के अक्षरों से (प्रत्येक अक्षर उतनी ही बार जितना दिखता है) कौन-सा शब्द बन सकता है?
questions.solution_en: PIRATE needs P, I, R, A, T, E, and every one of them appears in PRACTICE. CRICKET needs K, CARROT needs O and TRIPOD needs O and D, none of which appear.
questions.solution_hi: PIRATE में P, I, R, A, T, E चाहिए, और ये सभी PRACTICE में हैं। CRICKET में K, CARROT में O और TRIPOD में O तथा D चाहिए, जो नहीं हैं।
questions.trick_en: Count each letter before accepting a word.
questions.trick_hi: शब्द स्वीकार करने से पहले हर अक्षर गिनें।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.text_en: A person facing north turns 135° clockwise. Which direction is he facing now?
questions.text_hi: उत्तर की ओर मुख किया व्यक्ति 135° दक्षिणावर्त घूमता है। अब वह किस दिशा में मुख करेगा?
questions.solution_en: 90° clockwise gives east and a further 45° gives south-east.
questions.solution_hi: 90° दक्षिणावर्त से पूर्व और 45° और घूमने से दक्षिण-पूर्व।
questions.trick_en: Split 135° into 90° + 45°.

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.text_en: A cube painted on all faces is cut into 64 equal smaller cubes. How many smaller cubes have no painted face?
questions.text_hi: सभी फलकों पर रंगा घन 64 बराबर छोटे घनों में काटा जाता है। कितने छोटे घनों का कोई फलक रंगा नहीं होगा?
questions.solution_en: A 4 × 4 × 4 cut leaves an inner 2 × 2 × 2 block unpainted: (4 − 2)³ = 8.
questions.trick_en: Interior cubes = (n − 2)³.
questions.trick_hi: भीतरी घन = (n − 2)³।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.text_en: A clock shows 2:30. What time does its mirror image show?
questions.text_hi: घड़ी 2:30 दिखाती है। उसकी दर्पण छवि क्या समय दिखाएगी?
questions.solution_en: For a mirror image, subtract the time from 11:60: 11:60 − 2:30 = 9:30.
questions.trick_en: Use 11:60 − given time, not 12:00 − time.

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.text_en: Which grouping is correct: roses, flowers, red things?
questions.text_hi: कौन-सा समूह सही है: गुलाब, फूल, लाल वस्तुएँ?

options.en: All roses are flowers; some flowers are red
options.hi: All roses are flowers; some flowers are red

questions.solution_en: Roses lie inside flowers, and red objects overlap flowers without containing them.
questions.solution_hi: गुलाब फूलों के भीतर आते हैं, और लाल वस्तुएँ फूलों से प्रतिच्छेद करती हैं, उन्हें समाहित नहीं करतीं।
questions.trick_en: Draw flowers as a big circle and roses inside it.
questions.trick_hi: फूलों को बड़ा वृत्त और गुलाब को उसके भीतर बनाएँ।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.text_en: All successful athletes train daily. Ravi does not train daily. What follows?
questions.text_hi: सभी सफल खिलाड़ी प्रतिदिन अभ्यास करते हैं। रवि प्रतिदिन अभ्यास नहीं करता। क्या निकलता है?

options.en: Ravi is not a successful athlete
options.hi: Ravi is not a successful athlete

questions.solution_en: The statement is "all successful athletes train daily". Its contrapositive is "anyone who does not train daily is not a successful athlete".
questions.solution_hi: कथन है "सभी सफल खिलाड़ी प्रतिदिन अभ्यास करते हैं"। इसका contrapositive है "जो प्रतिदिन अभ्यास नहीं करता, वह सफल खिलाड़ी नहीं है"।
questions.trick_en: Use the contrapositive of "all A are B".
questions.trick_hi: "सभी A, B हैं" का contrapositive लें।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.text_en: Sales rose from 200 to 250. What is the percentage increase?
questions.text_hi: बिक्री 200 से 250 हो गई। प्रतिशत वृद्धि क्या है?
questions.solution_en: Increase = 50, so percentage increase = 50/200 × 100 = 25%.
questions.trick_en: Divide the increase by the original value.
questions.trick_hi: वृद्धि को मूल मान से भाग दें।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.text_en: A teammate makes a mistake during a group project and looks embarrassed. What is the most emotionally intelligent response?
questions.text_hi: समूह परियोजना में साथी गलती करता है और शर्मिंदा दिखता है। सबसे भावनात्मक रूप से बुद्धिमान प्रतिक्रिया क्या है?

options.en: Criticise them in front of everyone
options.hi: Criticise them in front of everyone

options.en: Talk privately, reassure them and fix the error together
options.hi: Talk privately, reassure them and fix the error together

questions.solution_en: Private, supportive correction protects dignity while still solving the problem.
questions.solution_hi: निजी और सहायक सुधार सम्मान बचाता है और समस्या भी हल करता है।
questions.trick_en: Choose the option that solves the problem without humiliating anyone.
questions.trick_hi: वह विकल्प चुनें जो किसी को अपमानित किए बिना समस्या हल करे।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.text_en: P is Q's brother. R is Q's mother. S is R's husband. How is P related to S?
questions.text_hi: P, Q का भाई है। R, Q की माँ है। S, R का पति है। P, S से कैसे संबंधित है?
questions.solution_en: R is P's mother too, and S is R's husband, so S is P's father and P is his son.
questions.solution_hi: R, P की भी माँ है, और S, R का पति है, इसलिए S, P के पिता हैं और P उनका पुत्र है।
questions.trick_en: If R is the mother of Q, she is also the mother of Q's brother P.
questions.trick_hi: यदि R, Q की माँ है, तो वह Q के भाई P की भी माँ है।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.text_en: In a row of 30 students, Riya is 9th from the left. What is her position from the right?
questions.text_hi: 30 विद्यार्थियों की पंक्ति में रिया बाएँ से 9वीं है। दाएँ से उसकी स्थिति क्या है?
questions.solution_en: Position from right = total − position from left + 1 = 30 − 9 + 1 = 22nd.
questions.trick_en: Add 1 after subtracting because both end positions are counted.
questions.trick_hi: घटाने के बाद 1 जोड़ें क्योंकि दोनों सिरे गिने जाते हैं।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.text_en: In a city index, Mumbai is 01, Delhi 02, Chennai 03 and Kolkata 04. Which code belongs to Chennai?
questions.text_hi: किसी शहर सूची में मुंबई 01, दिल्ली 02, चेन्नई 03 और कोलकाता 04 है। चेन्नई का कौन-सा कोड है?
questions.solution_en: The index lists Chennai as 03, so the matching code is 03.
questions.solution_hi: सूची में चेन्नई 03 है, इसलिए सही कोड 03 है।
questions.trick_en: Match the city name to its listed code before checking the options.
questions.trick_hi: विकल्प जाँचने से पहले शहर का नाम सूची में देखें।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.text_en: You have 10 minutes left in a section and 4 unattempted questions. What is the best strategy given −0.5 marking?
questions.text_hi: एक खंड में 10 मिनट बचे हैं और 4 प्रश्न अनुत्तरित हैं। −0.5 अंकन को देखते हुए सर्वोत्तम रणनीति क्या है?

options.en: Attempt only those where at least one option can be eliminated confidently
options.hi: Attempt only those where at least one option can be eliminated confidently

questions.solution_en: With negative marking, a guess is worth attempting only when elimination raises the expected value above zero.
questions.solution_hi: ऋणात्मक अंकन में अनुमान तभी लाभदायक है जब विकल्प हटाने से अपेक्षित मान शून्य से ऊपर हो।
questions.trick_en: Expected value = p(correct)×2 − p(wrong)×0.5.
questions.trick_hi: अपेक्षित मान = p(सही)×2 − p(गलत)×0.5।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.text_en: Statements: Some doctors are singers. All singers are dancers. Conclusions: I. Some doctors are dancers. II. All dancers are doctors. Which follows?
questions.text_hi: कथन: कुछ डॉक्टर गायक हैं। सभी गायक नर्तक हैं। निष्कर्ष: I. कुछ डॉक्टर नर्तक हैं। II. सभी नर्तक डॉक्टर हैं। कौन निकलता है?
questions.solution_en: The doctors who are singers must also be dancers, so conclusion I follows. Conclusion II reverses the relation and does not follow.
questions.solution_hi: जो डॉक्टर गायक हैं वे नर्तक भी होंगे, इसलिए निष्कर्ष I निकलता है। निष्कर्ष II संबंध उलटता है, इसलिए नहीं निकलता।
questions.trick_en: "Some A are B" plus "all B are C" gives "some A are C".
questions.trick_hi: "कुछ A, B हैं" और "सभी B, C हैं" से "कुछ A, C हैं" मिलता है।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.text_en: Which pair is correctly matched: 15 August : Independence Day?
questions.text_hi: कौन-सा युग्म सही मिलान है: 15 August : Independence Day?
questions.solution_en: 2 October is Gandhi Jayanti. 26 January is Republic Day, 15 August is Independence Day and 5 September is Teachers' Day.
questions.solution_hi: 2 अक्टूबर गांधी जयंती है। 26 जनवरी गणतंत्र दिवस, 15 अगस्त स्वतंत्रता दिवस और 5 सितंबर शिक्षक दिवस है।
questions.trick_en: Fix national dates by month: Jan 26, Aug 15, Oct 2.
questions.trick_hi: राष्ट्रीय तिथियाँ महीने से याद रखें: 26 जन, 15 अग, 2 अक्टूबर।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.text_en: Roll numbers 101–150 belong to Centre A and 151–200 to Centre B. Which centre does roll number 173 belong to?
questions.text_hi: रोल नंबर 101–150 केंद्र A और 151–200 केंद्र B के हैं। रोल नंबर 173 किस केंद्र का है?
questions.solution_en: 173 lies between 151 and 200, so it belongs to Centre B.
questions.solution_hi: 173, 151 और 200 के बीच है, इसलिए यह केंद्र B का है।
questions.trick_en: Locate the number in the correct range before answering.
questions.trick_hi: उत्तर देने से पहले संख्या को सही परास में खोजें।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ.
